means: The mirror of male focus - a danbooru tag saying the image is about the female figure.
does: In a mixed-gender frame it decides who the picture is about, which is real work no other tag does. On a lone-female shot it mostly duplicates what 1girl already did, because the checkpoint's prior leans female without being asked. So it is least useful exactly when it is most tempting to add, and most useful in the two-character shots this model is worst at.
reach_for_it: mixed-gender shots where the woman is the subject - skip it on a solo female close-up
used_in: unused - the current character library is male-only
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short black hair, dark jacket, standing on a rooftop, city skyline behind, late afternoon sun, looking away, masterpiece, best quality, very aesthetic, absurdres
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
